classify_api_error: classify an API error exception into a structured recovery recommendation with retry hints
create_classified_error: create a ClassifiedError dataclass instance with reason, status code, provider, and recovery action flags
classify_by_status_code: classify an API error based on HTTP status code with message-aware refinement for 401, 402, 429, 500, and 503 responses
classify_by_message_pattern: classify an API error by matching error message patterns against billing, rate limit, context overflow, and auth categories
extract_status_code_chain: extract an HTTP status code by walking the exception and its cause chain up to 5 levels deep
